scope_note: The last section of the guide still private. It was repaired once after the V7I audit, to supply the 247 CMR 15.04 quality-related-event retention the section had denied existed, and corrected again after V9F on how far the non-resident carve-out reaches: 247 CMR 20.02(5) exempts non-resident pharmacies from the reporting requirements in 20.02, while 20.07(1) keeps the rest of 247 CMR 20.00 on them, so 20.02(4)'s five-year retention still binds. The section now says so, states in its own words that the sentence is arguable, and shows why the five-year course is safe on either reading. It also carries the M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 15 police copies its learning objective promised, and the 105 CMR 700.004(A)(2)(f) point that an individual pharmacist can be a Department registrant. One additive rule, MA-DPH-PRACTITIONER-REGISTRATION, carries the latter. Scope gate: four actionable signals, all declined as other sections' declared subjects -- the general controlled-substance record duty, change-of-ownership reporting, federal registration by location, and registration term and renewal.
